{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your maximum number of {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} is increased by {c_number}[Affix_Value_2]{/c}. {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} cleave with their attacks and deal {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.

Commanding them onto a target increases the damage that target takes from your {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} by {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c}.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
